title: FAK Ops | Fleet Work in Flight & Agent Attribution

panels.title: FAK Ops | Fleet Work in Flight & Agent Attribution
panels.description:
Work that has not landed yet (by state and by worktree), and which harness / router model provider / lane each agent run used, how long it worked, how much of that was productive, and the public-vs-private ticket split.

**Honesty contract.** Each plane carries a `*_present` gauge. `0` means the plane is UNAVAILABLE (check `fak_ops_partial` and the `/status` diagnostics) - never a measured zero. An absent ledger folds as present-with-zero-rows. `productive` time is **DERIVED**, not observed: wall time of a run that landed a commit or made a tool call (see `fak_ops_agent_productive_definition`). The gap between wall and productive is suspected-idle time, shown deliberately.

panels.title: Unlanded total
panels.description: Total volume of unlanded work: worktrees whose census state is COMMITTED_UNLANDED, DIRTY_AND_UNLANDED, or ORPHAN_UNREGISTERED_WITH_UNLANDED_COMMIT. ALWAYS read this with the Census present / Census partial stats beside it: a partial census classifies unprobed rows UNKNOWN, so an unlanded total of 0 under census_partial=1 means "not observed", NOT "nothing outstanding".

panels.title: At-risk total
panels.description: At-risk worktrees from the same census (unlanded + dirty-uncommitted + unknown).

panels.title: Dirty (not unlanded)
panels.description: Dirty-but-not-unlanded worktrees: uncommitted WIP with no commits ahead of base. Deliberately NOT part of the unlanded total.

panels.title: Landed clean
panels.description: Worktrees classified landed-clean.

panels.title: Unknown state
panels.description: Worktrees whose state could not be classified. Never folded into the unlanded total.

panels.title: Census present
panels.description: 1 = a well-formed worktree census was folded; 0 = the unlanded plane is UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed).

panels.title: Census partial
panels.description: 1 = the census itself was partial (counts are lower bounds).

panels.title: Census age (s)
panels.description: Age of the folded census observation.

panels.title: Fleet-work plane
panels.description: 1 = at least one work/attribution plane was foldable.

panels.title: Unlanded total over time
panels.description: How the total volume of unlanded work moves over the selected range.

panels.title: Unlanded by state over time
panels.description: Unlanded worktrees partitioned by census state.

panels.title: Unlanded by worktree (top 15)
panels.description: Per-worktree unlanded breakdown, keyed by ticket id when known, else by path. Bounded to the top 15 by current value. Rows classified UNKNOWN by a partial census are NOT here.

panels.title: At-risk vs unlanded over time
panels.description: At-risk vs unlanded: the vertical gap is dirty-or-unknown work at risk but not yet unlanded.

panels.title: Fleet productive total (h)

panels.title: Productive share
panels.description: DERIVED productive time as a fraction of observed wall time, fleet-wide.
